title: Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2024
official_summary:
Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2024

This act requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to increase the amounts payable for wartime disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. Specifically, the VA must increase the amounts by the same percentage as the cost-of-living increase in benefits for Social Security recipients that is effective on December 1, 2024. The act requires the VA to publish the amounts payable, as increased, in the Federal Register.

The VA is authorized to make a similar adjustment to the rates of disability compensation payable to persons who have not received compensation for service-connected disability or death.

summary.headline: Raises VA disability and survivor payments by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase taking effect December 1, 2024.
summary.what_it_does: Requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to raise several benefit amounts by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase that starts December 1, 2024. This covers disability compensation, extra payments for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and payments to surviving spouses and children. The VA must publish the new amounts in the Federal Register. The VA may also make a similar increase for certain other people paid disability compensation under separate rules.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive VA disability compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their monthly payments go up by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase.
The extra payments they receive for spouses, children, or other dependents also increase.

who_it_affects.group: Disabled veterans who get the VA clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: The clothing allowance amount increases by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children of veterans who receive dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments increase by the same percentage.
